subject: The Shape of Sound - New approach for Bioacoustical analysis

messages.subject: The Shape of Sound - New approach for Bioacoustical analysis
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm happy to share the final version of the paper:
"The shape of sound: A new R package that crosses the bridge between Bioacoustics and Geometric Morphometrics".

SoundShape package aims to provide the tools required for anyone to implement the new and little explored eigensound method for Bioacoustical analysis. The method focuses on the direct comparison between homologous acoustic units from different species, using tools from bioacoustics (i.e. seewave) and Geometric Morphometric Methods. 

The paper can be downloaded directly from the publishers' site:
https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.13580

For theoretical background, codes and details on the eigensound method, I recommend the Supplementary File:
https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/action/downloadSupplement?doi=10.1111%2F2041-210X.13580&file=mee313580-sup-0001-Supinfo.pdf

I'd like to thank Jérôme for his help during the early stages of this work and for his permission to share the final product here. 

Thanks in advance for anyone's interest, and please feel free to email me any issues or interesting results.

Looking forward to getting some feedback from the bioacoustical community!

Regards,

Pedro
